label: USGS ShakeMap, one IM at each bridge, from grid.xml and uncertainty.xml

inputs.name: epsilon
inputs.description: This bridge's residual, from a field that carries the correlation between bridges.

imt.description: Which of the map's grids: PGA, PGV, PSA03, PSA10 or PSA30, with STD<field> from uncertainty.xml.

source.citation: USGS ShakeMap grid.xml and uncertainty.xml, PSA(1.0 s), read through src/builder/shakemap.py.

description: ln IM = ln median + sigma * epsilon, with the median from grid.xml (e.g. PSA10 for SA(1.0)) and sigma from uncertainty.xml (STDPSA10), both interpolated bilinearly on the log scale at the site. Deterministic given epsilon: the randomness, and the dependence between sites, live in the residual field. A bridge outside the map is an error, not zero shaking; a map without uncertainty.xml gives sigma = 0 and says so.
